title: Teriyaki Glazed Salmon
description: Perfectly cooked salmon fillets with a glossy teriyaki glaze. The fish is pan-seared to create a crispy exterior while remaining tender and flaky inside, then finished with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce.
instructions:
1. Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
2. In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, and ginger. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook until reduced by half and syrupy, about 8-10 minutes.
3. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Place salmon skin-side up and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden brown.
4. Carefully flip the salmon and cook for another 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
5. Brush the teriyaki glaze over the salmon and cook for 1 more minute, basting frequently.
6. Remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes.
7. Serve over steamed rice with steamed broccoli and drizzle with remaining teriyaki sauce.
8. Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
